checks.name: Starts v0.13 offline with correct title
Seconds and label avoidance default OFF
Clock accessible time excludes seconds by default
One same-size mode toggle after right rotation; footer mode button removed
Footer planet navigation stays screen centered
Left-click opens Apply Save Delete Cancel in order
Empty slot disables apply and delete only
Right-click opens the exact same menu for an empty slot
Cancel does not write an empty preset
Save writes camera angle, zoom, focus and both pan axes
Saved slot enables apply and delete
Apply initiates smooth transition instead of an immediate jump
Apply arrives exactly at saved camera
Number shortcut retains same smooth recall
Esc cancels without deleting a saved camera
Explicit delete affects only selected slot
Enabling seconds shows both separator and digits
Avoidance option drives the renderer and persisted settings
Turning seconds OFF hides whole group without changing simulation rate
Toolbar toggle enters zen and reflects pressed state
Zen idle hides toolbar and cursor, keeps Seoul readout
Mouse movement reveals same complete toolbar
Unified popup remains awake and usable in zen
Same toggle exits zen; normal toolbar not inert
Saved display options and camera slots load on next startup
No uncaught page errors

limitations: Offline HTML injection; localhost navigation returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR.
LocalStorage uses a test adapter on the opaque document origin.
Hardware GPU and actual Windows launch are not verified.
